tool.help:
@HELP_AUTHORS@
=================== xcms fillChromPeaks ===================
----------- Description -----------
**Gap filling : Integrate areas of missing peaks** After correspondence (grouping chromatographic peaks into features across samples), some features will be missing a peak in one or more samples. fillChromPeaks integrates the signal in the corresponding m/z and retention time region for those samples and adds it to the peak matrix, flagging the added values as "filled-in".
.. class:: warningmark
-------------------------- XCMS version 4 improvement --------------------------
Recommanded new method (ChromPeakAreaParam) to integrate area from the detected chromatographic peaks of a feature. **By default** using 25th/75th percentile of their m/z and rt boundaries (mzmin, mzmax,rtmin, rtmax) or their **median** if configurated in advanced options. Optional minMzWidthPpm parameter enforces a minimum m/z width (ppm) around feature's m/z.
Original xcms method is not supported for XcmsExperiment objects as it tends to underestimate peak area. The method is no longer maintened in the version.
